policy: Select published CVEs for contextual reasoning and breadth, never for an unmeasured claim that a scanner misses them. Published severity is copied under the existing source policy, not tuned to quotas.
replacement_notes: Twenty was user-suggested. Its two cases replace extra candidate cases MinIO CVE-2023-28433 and Cosign CVE-2022-35929 to preserve the 50-case size and project diversity. Those candidates were not rejected as false CVEs.
Next.js CVE-2025-30218 was not selected; prefer independent temporal trust reasoning in Cosign CVE-2026-24122 over a third Next.js case.

cases.mechanism_family: Trusting internal request headers
cases.expert_reasoning: Requires relating internal recursion safeguards, header provenance and an application authorization contract; no generic dangerous sink is necessary.
cases.selection_basis: Published flaw in a widely used project with contextual policy/state reasoning and inspectable source repair.

cases.mechanism_family: Request metadata changes cache eligibility
cases.expert_reasoning: Requires tracing request classification through rendering metadata into shared-cache policy and distinguishing dynamic routes and deployment modes.
cases.selection_basis: Published flaw in a widely used project with contextual policy/state reasoning and inspectable source repair.

cases.mechanism_family: Router and ORM empty-key semantics
cases.expert_reasoning: Requires combining route resolution, parameter extraction and ORM treatment of zero-valued struct fields.
cases.selection_basis: Published flaw in a widely used project with contextual policy/state reasoning and inspectable source repair.

cases.mechanism_family: Federated account linking by mutable username

cases.selection_basis: Published flaw in a widely used project with contextual policy/state reasoning and inspectable source repair.

cases.selection_basis: Published flaw in a widely used project with contextual policy/state reasoning and inspectable source repair.

cases.mechanism_family: Long-lived session ignores permission revocation

cases.selection_basis: Published flaw in a widely used project with contextual policy/state reasoning and inspectable source repair.

cases.expert_reasoning: Requires tracking data release and verification order across a streaming parser and its bounded consumer; the cryptographic check itself exists.
cases.selection_basis: Published flaw in a widely used project with contextual policy/state reasoning and inspectable source repair.

cases.selection_basis: Published flaw in a widely used project with contextual policy/state reasoning and inspectable source repair.

cases.mechanism_family: Valid log proof not bound to current signature
